message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Step | What Happens | Key Points | |------|--------------|------------| | **1. Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck (108 cards).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | • If the first card is an action card, its effect applies immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the next player draws two and skips a turn). | | **2. Turn Order** | • Players take turns clockwise (or counterclockwise if a “Reverse” card is played). | • The goal is to be the first to play all your cards. | | **3. Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play one card from your hand that matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard.
• You may also play a Wild card (any color) or a Wild Draw Four (any color + force next player to draw four). | • If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. | | **4. Drawing a Card** | • If you draw a playable card, you may play it immediately.
• If you cannot play it, your turn ends. | • If the draw pile runs out, reshuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile. | | **5. Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Same as Wild, but next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | • A “Wild Draw Four” can only be played if you have no other legal move; otherwise, the opponent can challenge you. | | **6. Challenging a Wild Draw Four** | • If you suspect the previous player lied about having no matching color, you can challenge.
• The challenger must show their hand.
• If the challenger was right, they must draw six cards (two for the original “Draw Four” + four penalty).
• If the challenger was wrong, they must draw eight cards (four for the “Draw Four” + four penalty). | • Only one challenge per “Wild Draw Four.” | | **7. Winning** | • When a player has no cards left, they shout “UNO!” if they’re down to one card.
• The round ends when someone plays their last card. | • Score points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **8. Game End** | • Play continues until a player reaches a target score (commonly 500). | • The player with the lowest total score wins. | --- ### Quick Tips - **Keep track of colors** – If you’re low on a particular color, try to play a Wild to change the color to something you have more of. - **Use action cards strategically** – Save a “Draw Two” or “Reverse” for when you’re close to winning to block opponents. - **Watch opponents’ hands** – If someone keeps drawing, they might be forced to pick up many cards if you play a “Wild Draw Four” correctly. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
